_meta.about: Numbers for cold arms whose wiki table leaves a hole the game cannot live with, laid over the frame by server/items.py after the wiki's own (same keys, frame shape unchanged). A key is taken only where the wiki gives no positive value for it, and a price only where the wiki gives none in either currency, so a fuller table, should one turn up, wins. DESIGNED, NOT RECOVERED: the original server kept these numbers and they are lost. Each record says in _designed what was chosen and in _source what is real.
_meta.decided: 2026-09-24, owner: Одноглазый (5222, Караван) sells cold arms for levels 0-8, the plain and the gold copy of each like Борис sells his pistols, nothing premium. The level-0 one, knife_lvl0_A (the wiki's Булыжник), is the only one whose article lacks numbers a stall needs. 2026-10-12, the Абри restoration (the owner's «Добавь каждому продавцу нужные предметы»): Фрея Каплан's 24 gifts (gift_kid_1..10, gift_girl_1..10, gift_0..3), whose articles give every number a stall needs but the action points and whose icons tie no record of data/items_wiki.json but Букет's -- without these records they were the designed frame's weapons, 13-40 damage at 70-700 afro. 2026-10-14, the Абу-Хамед restoration (the owner's «сделай потом абу хамед в таком же формате»): the three sharpened Мачете (G) of «Точильный камень Абу-Хамеда» (2282, data/build_weaponcraft.py), whose articles «Мачете Mod I/II/III» draw the plain knife's icon (Knife lvl20 G.png), so the linker tied them to Мачете (G) itself below its confidence and data/items_wiki.json has no record of theirs -- without these records a sharpened Мачете was the designed frame's knife, 95 wear at 70 afro. Their numbers are the articles' all, nothing designed.
_meta.fields: ss_si_coldarm names as in server/items.py; cost in afro, g_cost in hundredths of G (0.01 G = 1), like items_wiki.json. Keys starting with _ never reach the wire.
